data.content: Creation handoff: This correction closes the remaining read-path trust gap. Provider policy and exact provider-returned OIDs, never plain Git content, must authorize ValidatedProtection. Fetch exact immutable bytes, recheck policy/control freshness, and then enter the schema-v22 SyncService apply boundary. GitHub and Diffinite fixtures plus disposable live probes are mandatory. Existing operator approval covers both provider control work and SQLite application; do not introduce a later approval gate. Preserve every legacy/archive/generation/pack/event/inbox/Git object.
